# Phaos AI

> Pre-seed pitch deck for Phaos AI — autonomous voice agents and agentic workflow automation as a digital workforce for the document solutions and printing industry.

Phaos AI deploys deeply integrated intelligent voice agents that bridge inbound telephony and legacy ERPs through agentic workflow orchestration. This site hosts the company's investor pitch deck.

## Pages

- [Pitch Deck](/): Interactive pre-seed investor presentation covering the opportunity, product, market, financials, and team.
